metaTitle: Iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ — Baal Hammon, Tanit, Melqart, Eshmoun
metaDesc: Ddin aqarṭaǧi : Baal Hammon, Tanit, Melqart, Eshmoun, Astarté, Déméter d Korè, ixxamen n tẓallit, ikahinen, tirrayin n umḍal akked umseqsi ɣef tofet n Salammbô.
title: Iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ
lede: I d-ikkan seg Ṣur, iyilluten ifiniqiyen ṭṭfen deg Afrika udem amaynut, yemlalen d laman ilibikiyen.
baalAlt: Baal Hammon yeqqim ɣef ukersi, s fexxar
baalCap: Baal Hammon yeqqim ɣef ukersi, s fexxar
lionCap: Tayillut s uqerru n izem, teqqen ɣer Tanit
gods.0.name: Baal Hammon
gods.0.text: Yillu ameqqran, bab n igenni d tfeṛwelt, ittwabeggen d amɣar s tmart ɣef ukersi i sselmen snat n tsfinksat.
gods.1.name: Tanit
gods.1.text: « Udem n Baal », taḥadrayt n tmdint. Acaraf-is — akuẓan, tagzirt, tasaweɛt — yella anida kan, armi d lqaɛa n Kerkuan.
gods.2.name: Melqart
gods.2.text: « Agellid n temdint », yillu n Ṣur ; Qarṭaǧ tettazen-as-d yal aseggas asfel. At Barka sbeggnen-t ɣef yiṣuraf-nsen.
gods.3.name: Eshmoun
gods.3.text: Yillu amjelleb. Axxam n tẓallit-is yezzuɣur Byrsa : dinna i ruḥen ineggura yemmuggaren deg 146.
tophetP1: Amḍiq n tẓallit ldin i yigenni anda ufan-d azal n walaf n ifexxaren yețwazedɣen s wayen i d-yeqqimen n warrac, s iẓran i ulɣuman i Baal Hammon d Tanit sennig-sen.
tophetP2a: Imeskaren igrikiyen d iṛumaniyen ttwalin dinna isfal. Imesneɣzuyen ur mṣadan ara ger uẓawan n usfel d tasga n imeḍlan n warrac imecṭuḥ : amseqsi-agi yettwabeggen deg usebter n
pantheonAside: Agraw-agi n iyilluten aqarṭaǧi, ɣas ismawen-is grikiyen neɣ ilatiniyen deg yiɣbula (Sznycer), d asamit alɣarbi s telqey, yerna-d s lemqabla d Ilibikiyen, Imasriyen d Igrikiyen.
more.0.name: Astarté
more.0.text: Tayillut n tfeṛwelt d umenɣi, mazal-itt tettwaqadar di Qarṭaǧ. Imukan n tẓallit-is ttwassnen aṭas, am win n Tas Silg di Malṭa neɣ win n Éryx di Sicile.
more.1.name: Reshef
more.1.text: Yillu n umenɣi d lehlakat, Igrikiyen qerben-t ɣer Apollon. Tanezlit-is tettwaf deg umaḍal apuni d ufiniqi meṛṛa.
more.2.k: Yillu ur yettwassen ara s telqey
more.2.name: Sakon
more.2.text: Yettwassen abeɛda s tira n tezkert d yismawen n imdanen i t-id-nedhun ; tawuri-ines s telqey mazal-itt d tuffra.
more.3.name: Baal Shamim
more.3.text: Yillu ameqqran n igenni n Ifiniqiyen. Tira n tezkert deg tegzirt n San Pietro, di Sardaigne, tettbeggen tanezlit-is deg Lɣarb apuni.
more.4.name: Sid
more.4.text: Yettwaqadar di Sardaigne, anda Iṛumaniyen ad as-semman Sardus Pater (axxam n tẓallit n Antas). Di Qarṭaǧ, tira n tezkert qernent-t ɣer Tanit : Sid-Tanit.
more.5.name: Isis, Horus, Bès
more.5.text: Tihrisin, sskarabiyat d ulmasen ițwaɣzan sduklen-d iyilluten imasriyen, i d-yusan seg lqern wis 7 neɣ ittwanɣalen dagi, abeɛda deg yimḍalen n tilawin d warrac.
more.6.name: Déméter et Korè
more.6.text: Lɛesker n Himilcon yekkes ayen akk yellan deg umḍiq-nsent n tẓallit, ɣer tama n Syracuse, imbeɛd lwebba tenɣa aṭas. Iwakken ad sserseḍent, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef tanezlit-nsent tefka-tt i ikahinen igrikiyen (Diodore, XIV, 63 d 77).
more.7.name: Iyilluten ibeddlen
more.7.text: Melqart yeddem udem n Héraclès ; Baal Hammon yettqerrib ɣer Ammon alibiki s yiqeṛṛi n ikerri, imbeɛd ɣer Jupiter. Ddaw Ṛuma, yedder deg Saturne afriqan, Tanit deg Caelestis.
oathText: Mi gerzef Hanibal tagallelt akked Philippe V n Macédoine, tagallelt-nni tettwagall zdat n iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ. Polybe yura-ten-id s yismawen igrikiyen : Zeus, Héra d Apollon, « amjeɛluf » iḥadren iqarṭaǧiyen, Héraclès d Iolaos, Arès, Triton, Poséidon, imbeɛd Yiṭij, Aggur d Tmurt. Imesnezruyen walan deg-sen Baal Hammon, Tanit, Melqart neɣ Reshef, war ma akk mṣadan ɣef lemqabla.
sanct.0.v: Akken i d-yeqqar Appien, axxam n tẓallit n Eshmoun, ameqqran akteṛ di Qarṭaǧ, yezzuɣur tiɣilt. Wayen yellan sennig, ittwakkes deg tallit taṛumanit, ulac ayen i d-yeqqimen (Beschaouch).
sanct.1.v: Axxam n tẓallit n Melqart yeqqim-d yettwassen armi d tallit taṛumanit.
sanct.2.v: Imukan n tẓallit drus ugar ɣer tama n teɣsert n TGM n Salammbô n wussan-a akked ɣer uḍar n Sidi Bou Said. Ɣer rrif n lebḥer, ixxamen n tẓallit ṭṭfen-d isfal akked tikfawin n ibarraniyen.
sanct.3.v: Deg Ras Tib, amḍiq n tẓallit n taddart seg tazwara n Tagelda, s tesraḥ qeṛben i wa i wa s tagmat n Ccerq, ufan-d din tiwlafin n fexxar n Baal Hammon ger snat tsfinksat, n Tanit s uqerru n izem akked Déméter.
sanct.4.v: Kra n imukan n tẓallit llan d imukan ifazen kan, tikwal deg ifran : amkan-nsen ur ittabaɛ ara ula d yiwet n lqanun ur nebeddel.
clergy.0: Ddin yella d tamsalt n lḥekma. Ɣas ur ssewjaden ara tasertit, ikahinen, ttwarnan s urtaben, sɛan azal ameqqran deg tmetti yesɛan ddin s telqey ; tiwuriwin tiɛlayanin ttɣimint i twaculin timeqqranin (Dridi).
clergy.1: Isfal ttabaɛen ssumat yettwabeggnen deg ixxamen n tẓallit : i yal aɣersiw d yal ttlaba, sbedden amur n yillu, amur n ukahin d umur n umɛabed. Azru yeḥfaḍ imbeɛd asfel-nni.
clergyTags.1: Ittwaf di Marseille, d aqarṭaǧi n lɛerq
funAside: Imḍalen d lxrab ipuniyen imezwura i yettwaɣzan, seg tagara n lqern wis 19 — d wid yesɛan ugar n tɣawsiwin ɣef laman deg tudert mbeɛd lmut.
puigAlt: Imḍalen iɣezzun deg uẓru, tasga n imḍalen n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
puigCap: Tasga n imḍalen tapunit n Puig des Molins, Ibiza
fun.0.v: Ttwaseflent s tuɣmas ɣer Qarṭaǧ, sɛant-d afaylu n tlisa i ibeddlen n tmdint (Picard).
fun.1.v: Ttwaɣzant deg uẓru axir n ma d ttwabnant : lbir dakken s ṣṣanduq ɣer lqaɛa, lbir s waṭas n tswiɛin neɣ adeddi yettawin ɣer texxamt n umḍal. Ṣṣanduq n leɛwad ur nruẓ ara, ulac win i t-yecban, yusa-d seg Kerkuan.
fun.2.v: D ammud ameqqran, ɣas akken asseṛɣ yezmer ugar deg kra n tallit, am di Puig des Molins.
fun.3.v: Fexxar, lzyada, tihrisin, akal azeggaɣ — idammen, yeɛni tudert —, tiglayin n negg ițwaṣebɣen — talalit tis snat —, lkanapat timecṭuḥin s uklal.
fun.4.v: Ulmasen n nnḥas aḥmayan, ițwaɣzan seg lqern wis 5, qqnen ɣer uzizdeg n yemmuten (Lancel).
fun.5.v: Tiwlafin n imḍalen n Jbel Mlezza, deg Ras Tib, ttbanen-d am akken sbeggnent tikli n ruḥ n yemmuten.
maskAlt: Akellus apuni iwɛiren, asidag n Bardo
maskD: Akellus apuni iwɛiren. Ttwasersen deg yimḍalen, ikellusen-agi, war ccekk, sɛan tawuri n leḥris.
quote: « I wagdud-agi n yibeḥriyen, Tamdint n igenni d lmirsa aneggaru anda ara awḍen. »
